memory_update.text: ATGE should remain a reference/direct-capacity anchor for healthcare education because clinical affiliation agreements are explicitly disclosed as a growth constraint.
LOPE is a strong underfollowed candidate for the clinical/lab capacity node via Orbis and off-campus ABSN laboratory sites; verify ABSN site economics and clinical-network dependence.

node: Clinical placement, apprenticeship administration, simulation labs, and hands-on training capacity
summary: Layer 1B expansion found four US-listed public companies with plausible direct or second-order exposure to the hands-on capacity bottleneck in education/workforce training. The cleanest direct capacity names are Adtalem and Grand Canyon Education through healthcare/nursing education, clinical affiliations, off-campus labs, and employer-linked pathways. Universal Technical Institute adds hands-on trade and healthcare campus capacity via UTI and Concorde. HealthStream is the software/compliance layer: not a placement network pure-play, but exposed to healthcare workforce development, credentialing, scheduling, clinical development, nursing schools, and direct-to-student networks. No buy/sell view is implied.
